version: v3 — 质量底线 + 必要性过滤器
derived_from: ship SKILL.md 发布工作流八步法
canary SKILL.md 金丝雀监控核心职责
design_philosophy: Shipping & Delivery 的核心资产是'工作流八步顺序不可颠倒'与'发布后必须监控'铁律。提纯策略：保留关键步骤的强制措辞，压缩脚本命令细节、AskUserQuestion 格式模板、telemetry logging 字段说明等辅助信息

non_negotiable: Ship 触发门控原文：use when asked to "ship"/"deploy"/"push to main"/"create a PR"
版本控制流程核心：VERSION bump + CHANGELOG entry 必现
Code review gate: review diff before pushing/merging
Canary always-on 铁律：EVERY DEPLOY MUST BE MONITORED
Post-deploy monitoring 三要素：console errors/performance regressions/page failures
Diff-aware mode: git diff main...HEAD → affected pages → deploy port detection
Baseline.json regression diffing 机制存在
compressible: Preamble gstack-skill-start 脚本完整命令（仅保留调用示意）
AskUserQuestion 格式详细模板（简化为结构化要点）
Prose fallback 失败回退的具体文字描述（保留决策逻辑即可）
Telemetry 日志具体字段说明（保留命令示例即可）
Continuous Checkpoint Mode WIP commit 格式细节（保留前缀规则即可）
Eureka 洞见记录脚本的具体 jq 语法（保留命令名称即可）

prompt_template.input: 完成代码的分支名/功能描述 + 目标环境（staging/prod）
instructions: 1. Detection: identify branch with feature commits, check for test results
2. Version Bump: bump VERSION number (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH convention), document in CHANGELOG
3. Test Run: ensure all tests pass (unit + integration + e2e)
4. Code Review: generate review checklist for changes, request approvals if required
5. Merge Strategy: create PR or merge to main based on workflow
6. Deploy: push to production (Vercel/other platforms as configured)
7. Canary Monitoring: run post-deploy checks for console errors/performance/page failures
8. Baseline Update: save health score and issues to baseline.json for future regression comparison
9. NEVER skip monitoring step after deployment

line_patterns.ship_trigger_gate: "ship"|"deploy"|"push to main"|"create a PR" (exact quotes from trigger list)
line_patterns.canary_always_on: EVERY DEPLOY MUST BE MONITORED|post-deploy monitoring is mandatory

mechanical_audit_spec.verdict: 全部 5 项 pattern 通过 = 提纯成功；任何一项缺失 = 回到 baseline 诊断

success_criteria: 输出文档行数 ≤ baseline 的 60%
Ship 触发门控六类关键词出现 ≥1 次
VERSION bump + CHANGELOG entry 配对出现
Review diff gate 明确出现在 merge 之前
Canary monitoring 铁律原文至少出现一次
Diff-aware mode 七步流程覆盖完整或明确标注为可选
Regression diffing baseline.json 机制存在
无凑数内容（禁止 '至少 N 个元素' 式计数规则）
